machine_end_gcode.default_value:
M400 ; Wait for moves to finish
G92 E0 ; Reset extruder position
G1 E-1 F1800 ; Retract filament
G91 ; Use relative positioning
G1 Z2 F1200 ; Lift nozzle
G90 ; Return to absolute positioning
G1 X0 Y220 F5000 ; Move bed forward for print removal
M104 S0 ; Turn off nozzle heater
M140 S0 ; Turn off bed heater
M107 ; Turn off print cooling fan
M84 ; Disable steppers

machine_start_gcode.default_value:
M140 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} ; Set bed temperature
M104 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} ; Set nozzle temperature
G90 ; Use absolute positioning
M82 ; Use absolute extrusion
G28 ; Home all axes
M420 S1 ; Enable saved bed leveling mesh
M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} ; Wait for bed temperature
M109 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} ; Wait for nozzle temperature
G92 E0 ; Reset extruder position
G1 Z2 F3000 ; Lift nozzle
G1 X5 Y5 F5000 ; Move to purge line start
G1 Z0.28 F3000 ; Set purge line height
G1 X205 Y5 E10 F1200 ; Prime nozzle along front of bed
G92 E0 ; Reset extruder position
